description: Returns one Accessibility Scan by id: its website, sitemap, status, dates and page counts, and once completed its results: the run summary (pages measured on both viewports, templates sampled, and the note on what automated checks can and cannot show), the per-template roll-up of failing checks (the 20 largest templates and up to 25 of the most widespread failing checks each, with the totals), and on a re-scan the fix verification against the earlier scan as counts (fixed, still failing or not confirmed). results is null until the scan completes; on a completed scan whose stored results could not be read, results_unavailable is true and the results are in the Yellowhead app. Automated checks cover only part of WCAG, so a page with no failing check is not thereby shown to meet it. The per-page results are in the Yellowhead app.
name: get_accessibility_scan
title: Get an Accessibility Scan
